qianwen-audio-tts.purpose_zh: 使用 Qwen TTS 把文字转成配音或朗读音频；不用于语音识别。
qianwen-audio-tts.purpose_en: Convert text into voiceovers or read-aloud audio with Qwen TTS; not speech recognition.

qianwen-find-skills.purpose_zh: 发现、比较千问发布的 Agent Skills，并在用户要求时安装选定技能。
qianwen-find-skills.purpose_en: Discover and compare published QianWen Agent Skills, installing a selected skill only when requested.

qianwen-image-generation.purpose_zh: 通过 Wan 与 Qwen Image 模型生成或编辑图片，支持参考图改图、风格转换和图文输出。
qianwen-image-generation.purpose_en: Generate or edit images with Wan and Qwen Image, including reference-based edits, style transfer, and text-image output.

qianwen-model-selector.purpose_zh: 比较千问模型的能力、参数和价格，为具体任务选择模型；不负责其他厂商模型选型。
qianwen-model-selector.purpose_en: Compare Qwen capabilities, parameters, and pricing to choose a model for a task; not a selector for other providers.

qianwen-ops-auth.purpose_zh: 配置千问 API 密钥与接口端点，排查凭据缺失、401 和认证失败；密钥不写入报告。
qianwen-ops-auth.purpose_en: Configure Qwen API credentials and endpoints and diagnose missing credentials or authentication errors; keep secrets out of reports.

qianwen-payment.purpose_zh: 查询 QianWenAI 现金余额、充值订单及结果；仅在确认金额后发起充值，不用于普通商户付款。
qianwen-payment.purpose_en: Query QianWenAI cash balance, recharge orders, and results. Start a recharge only after the amount is confirmed; not for unrelated merchant payments.

qianwen-text.purpose_zh: 调用千问模型完成对话、文字生成、推理、代码编写和函数调用；不用于图片或视频生成。
qianwen-text.purpose_en: Use Qwen for conversation, text generation, reasoning, coding, and function calling; not image or video generation.

qianwen-update-check.purpose_zh: 检查 qianwen-ai 是否有新版本并提示更新信息；不是所有 AI 软件的通用更新工具。
qianwen-update-check.purpose_en: Check for qianwen-ai updates and report available versions; not a general updater for all AI software.

qianwen-usage.purpose_zh: 管理千问账号登录，查询用量、账单、订阅和调用日志；充值请使用“千问余额与充值”。
qianwen-usage.purpose_en: Manage QianWen sign-in and inspect usage, bills, subscriptions, and request logs. Use qianwen-payment for recharges.

qianwen-video-generation.purpose_zh: 通过 Wan 与 HappyHorse 模型制作或编辑视频，支持文字、图片、首尾帧和参考角色输入。
qianwen-video-generation.purpose_en: Generate or edit videos with Wan and HappyHorse using text, images, first and last frames, or reference characters.

qianwen-vision.purpose_zh: 让千问分析已有图片或视频，读取文字、图表和场景信息；这是视觉理解，不是生成图片或视频。
qianwen-vision.purpose_en: Analyze existing images and videos with Qwen, including OCR, charts, and scene information; visual understanding, not media generation.

qianwenai-deploy.purpose_zh: 将项目部署或更新到阿里云国内站；先确认资源费用与上线范围，再创建资源并验证服务。
qianwenai-deploy.purpose_en: Deploy or update a project on Alibaba Cloud's China site, confirming resource costs and release scope before provisioning and service verification.

qianwenai-observe.purpose_zh: 只读检查 qianwenai-deploy 已部署应用的健康、性能与费用；需要项目中的部署状态文件。
qianwenai-observe.purpose_en: Read health, performance, and costs for an app deployed by qianwenai-deploy, using its project deployment-state file.

qianwenai-operate.purpose_zh: 诊断 qianwenai-deploy 应用故障，说明影响并逐项确认后执行恢复，再验证实际结果。
qianwenai-operate.purpose_en: Diagnose a qianwenai-deploy app, explain impact, confirm each recovery action, then execute and verify the result.

typesafe-ai.purpose_zh: 用 TypeSafe／Jev 将自然语言转成带类型的判断与概率，辅助分类、排序和核验；模型判断不等于事实或执行授权。
typesafe-ai.purpose_en: Use TypeSafe and Jev to turn natural language into typed judgments and probabilities for classification, ranking, and verification; judgments are not facts or action authorization.

yao-geo-baidu-keywords.purpose_zh: 采集百度联想词与相关搜索，按行业和转化目标判断商业价值，整理成带截图的 Excel；不提供搜索量或竞价数据。
yao-geo-baidu-keywords.purpose_en: Collect Baidu suggestions and related searches, assess commercial intent for an industry, and deliver an Excel workbook with screenshots; not search-volume or bid data.
